name: National Assembly
notes: 336 seats (266 general, 60 reserved for women, 10 for non-Muslims). Party counts are the totals of the National Assembly's own party-wise member lists (na.gov.pk, members_listing by party, general plus reserved seats) read on 2026-11-11: 332 members, so 4 seats are shown as vacant. The 75 independents on the opposition benches and the 4 on the government benches are the Assembly's own categories; party labels follow its lists. JUI-F is the Assembly's Jamiat Ulama-e-Islam Pakistan.

name: Senate
notes: 96 seats. Party counts from the Senate Secretariat's party-wise list of members dated 21 April 2026 (all 96 seats filled; the 15 independents are listed as 3 on the treasury side, 9 on the opposition side and 3 not yet joined to either).
